Un compte de jeu et un visuel approuvé s: A game account and an approved creative are required. Credits are granted to the signed-in account after Stripe confirms payment. Closing the window or returning to the game does not confirm payment.

Les fonds placés peuvent être déplacés v: Committed funds can be moved to another eligible country but do not automatically return to the wallet. Each batch expires 30 days after its first placement, even if moved, outbid or still leading. A top-up does not extend earlier batches.

Le visuel du sponsor éligible en tête es: The leading eligible sponsor's creative appears in the territory. A tie preserves the incumbent. No number of views, clicks or days in the lead is guaranteed: another bid may replace the creative. Remaining credits can be moved before they expire.

Committed funds can be moved between countries but never returned to the wallet; they expire 30 days after their first placement. Moving funds never extends that period. Bids start at €2 depending on the country; wallet top-ups start at €5.
